text: Each watcher runs its plumbing builds' sandbox checks through one queue, one at a time by default, while their agent runs stay parallel (#458). -check-parallel sets how many for a bigger machine, apart from -parallel's agent slots. The agent's test tool, in its own MCP process, and the factory's fresh checks after a build, a fallback or a repair all join the queue. The watcher serves it on a private socket and runs each check itself, so a slot stays held through the sandbox's cleanup. A check's twelve-minute deadline starts when it's admitted, so waiting can't cut its tests short. The wait does count against the build's own time allowance, so a build can't wait forever, and meanwhile its status and the dashboard say waiting for checks. On 2026-11-03, #433's retry failed when its checks ran beside two other builds': the shared test budget ran out with tests unstarted, and the memory limit likely killed a process. At the merge, the queue's tests passed three times each, shuffled, under the race detector. The real-image budget check waits for a moment when no build is checking on the machine, since it runs real sandboxes outside the queue.
